gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all available project types in Jira so that I can choose the appropriate type for my new project.
gold.ideal: The response should include a list of all project types with their keys and names, allowing me to understand the options available.

gold.user: As a team member, I need to see all project types that I have access to, so I can select one for my new project.
gold.ideal: The response should return only the project types that I have permissions to use, along with their details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to get detailed information about a specific project type using its key, so I can understand its configuration.
gold.ideal: The response should provide comprehensive details about the specified project type, including its name, description, and any relevant settings.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to check if a specific project type is accessible to my team members, so I can manage permissions effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should indicate whether the specified project type is accessible to the current user, along with any relevant access details.
